design.name: Nightwalk Pocket Deck — Revision 2
design.font_family: Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI
design.rationale: The first build read as a generic dashboard for four reasons. There was no physical hierarchy. Every glyph came from Unicode at a different 8–12px size. The three hero objects (artwork, LCD, pad) sat on different vertical centres with uneven side margins (22px left, 4px right). Loose text sat on the bare shell. This revision returns to the reference: a moulded handheld shell carrying three objects on one centre line (y=108). On the left is a machined record bezel holding the generated vinyl artwork. In the middle is a recessed backlit blue LCD that holds all text and state. On the right is a domed four-way transport pad with a glossy centre play key. Under these, a single aligned rail holds volume (matching the bezel's width) and a segmented navigation control (matching LCD plus pad). When the shell expands, that rail becomes the tab bar of the drawer, so navigation is never shown twice. All iconography is one hand-drawn SVG set on a 24-unit grid with a 1.75 stroke, drawn at 20px in transport and 18px everywhere else, always inside a 32px hit target. Typography uses only fonts that ship with Windows. Segoe UI Variable handles Latin, Malgun Gothic handles Hangul (never below 12px), and Bahnschrift SemiCondensed is the retro numeric LCD face. Spacing is a strict 4px grid with 16px outer and inter-object gutters.

layout.units: Logical px at 100% scale. Keep the 4px grid. Origin is the top-left of the painted shell. If a drop shadow is used, add a 12px transparent margin outside these coordinates and offset everything by it.

title_strip.drag_region: the whole strip except the buttons

brand.label: Nightwalk at x=38, baseline-centred at y=18, Segoe UI Variable Text 12px Semibold, muted color, letter-spacing 0.2px

title_strip.button_icon: 18px centred. Each button is a flat ghost button at rest. Hover adds a radius-8 fill of text color at 8% alpha. Close on hover uses #E5484D fill with a white icon.

record_bezel.progress_arc: 3px round-cap arc on radius 63, starting at 12 o'clock and running clockwise. The track is border color at 50%; the fill is the accent.
record_bezel.spindle: 6px dot at the centre with a radial gradient #FFFFFF→#9AA6B6. Draw it only over custom covers, because the default cover already has one.

rows.content: Source pill on the left (LOCAL or YOUTUBE: Bahnschrift SemiCondensed 10px, letter-spacing 0.8px, 16px tall, horizontal padding 6px, radius 4, 1px border in LCD accent at 60%, fill at 12%). Format text on the right ('WAV · 44.1kHz', Bahnschrift SemiCondensed 11px, LCD muted).
15px Bold. Korean uses Malgun Gothic Bold, Latin uses Segoe UI Variable Semibold. LCD text color, elided at the right. Marquee scroll starts after 2s of hover only.
4px track at y=132. Track is white at 18%, fill is the LCD accent. A 12px knob appears only on hover or drag. The full 16px height is the hit area.
Elapsed on the left and remaining on the right ('-3:24'). Bahnschrift SemiCondensed 12px with tabular figures, LCD text at 85%.

lcd.empty_state: The title reads '재생할 곡이 없습니다'. The artist reads '폴더를 추가하거나 YouTube에서 검색하세요'. The seek bar is disabled at 40% opacity and the time shows '--:--'. This replaces the loose status line that sat on the shell.

play_key.glyph: play or pause at 24px. The play glyph is offset +1.5px on x for optical centring.

transport_pad.hit_test: Use a circular mask on the pad. The play key wins inside r=27. Outside that, split the pad into 4 angular quadrants rotated 45°, so the whole ring is clickable rather than only the 32px squares.
transport_pad.toggle_state: When shuffle or repeat is on, the icon turns accent-colored and a 4px accent dot appears 3px outside the icon, toward the pad rim. Repeat-one swaps to the repeat-1 icon.

value_label.font: Bahnschrift SemiCondensed 12px, tabular, muted, right-aligned, no % sign

nav_segmented.aligned_to: LCD left edge through pad right edge, x 164–564
nav_segmented.segment_content: 18px icon, a 6px gap, then the label in Malgun Gothic 12px. The pair is centred in its segment. Separators between inactive segments are 1px × 14px in border color at 60%.
nav_segmented.behaviour: Clicking an inactive segment expands the shell and opens that view. Clicking the active segment collapses the shell.

removed: the resize grip in compact mode

expanded.top_section: Identical to collapsed y 0–224. The nav segmented control is now the active tab bar. The active segment gets a 2px accent underline at y=218, inset 24px.

search_field.placeholder: 곡, 앨범 검색 또는 YouTube 주소
search_field.clear_button: 18px icon in a 28px hit area at the right

section_header.right: Sort menu 'Recently added ▾'. Use the chevron-down SVG at 16px, not a Unicode character.

row.art: 36px circle at x=40, y=row+8. Thumbnails get a 1px border in border color.
row.title: x=88, y=row+8, h=18. 13px Semibold (Malgun Gothic Bold for Korean), text color, elided before x=448
row.meta: x=88, y=row+28, h=16. 12px Regular, muted. Source and album separated by '·' with 4px spaces
row.duration: rect x 456–504, vertically centred. Bahnschrift SemiCondensed 12px, tabular, muted, right-aligned
row.more_button: 32x32 at x=512, vertically centred. Visible on hover or selection only; keep the space reserved
row.divider: 1px border color at 50%, from x=88 to x=544, on the bottom edge. None after the last row
row.hover: Radius-10 rect inset 4px horizontally, accent at 7%
row.selected: Accent at 13%, plus a 3px × 24px accent bar at x=30, vertically centred, radius 1.5
row.now_playing: Title turns accent-colored. The duration is replaced by an animated 3-bar equalizer icon (18px)

list.scrollbar: Overlay, 4px wide at x=548 (6px on hover), radius 3, text color at 22%. No arrows or groove. Fades out after 800ms idle
list.clip_rule: The list viewport ends at y=568. The footer is a separate layout item and must never overlap the list.

footer.right_text: '3곡 선택됨', 12px, muted, right-aligned to x=552. Hidden when nothing is selected

view_variants.queue: Same rows. The art is replaced by an 18px drag handle at x=34 plus a 36px art at x=58, and the text shifts to x=106. The header reads '다음 재생 5곡' with a ghost '비우기' button on the right. The now-playing row is pinned at the top.
view_variants.playlists: Same 52px rows. The art becomes a 36px radius-8 2×2 mosaic. Meta reads '곡 12개 · 48분'. The toolbar replaces the source toggle with a '새 재생목록' secondary button (plus icon) at [28,244,124,32].
view_variants.video: Video surface at [28,244,524,295], 16:9, radius 10, #000 fill, 1px border. Title row at [28,551,524,20] (13px Semibold). Below it, at y=578, three 32px icon buttons: fullscreen, picture-in-picture and open-in-browser. Transport stays on the pad; do not duplicate it.

expanded.animation: Animate window height 240→640 with QVariantAnimation, 220ms, OutCubic. Drawer opacity runs 0→1 over 160ms, starting 60ms in. Collapsing reverses this over 180ms with InCubic. If the screen's bottom edge would clip, grow upward instead by moving y in the same animation.

refinements: DEFECT 1 – Unbalanced margins: the artwork started at x=22 while the pad ended 4px from the right edge, and the pad looked clipped. FIX: 16px outer margin on all sides and 16px gutters (bezel 16–148, LCD 164–412, pad 428–564).

DEFECT 2 – Three different vertical centres: the artwork centre was about 97, the LCD about 97 but stretched to 154, and the pad about 90. FIX: bezel, LCD and pad all centre on y=108. Heights are 132, 120 and 136, so the LCD reads as recessed between two raised objects.

DEFECT 3 – The artwork showed a '밤' glyph on a flat disc instead of the generated cover. FIX: load assets/default-cover.png. Crop the centre 92% to drop the dark margin, scale to 112px × devicePixelRatio with SmoothTransformation and clip to a circle. While playing, rotate only the image at 1 revolution per 6s (QTimer at 16ms, or 33ms on battery). Paint a static sheen overlay on top so the highlights stay fixed while the grooves move. Pausing freezes the angle with no reset.

DEFECT 4 – The transport used tiny Unicode glyphs (⤨ ‹ › ↻) at about 8px with uneven weights. FIX: SVG icons only, 20px on direction keys and 24px for play, on the 47px radius described in the layout.

DEFECT 5 – The title-bar ◇ theme button showed a permanent orange focus ring and was a different size from ⚙ − ×. FIX: four identical 32px ghost buttons with 18px SVGs. Set focusPolicy to Qt.TabFocus. The focus ring shows only for keyboard focus: 2px accent, 2px offset, radius 10.

DEFECT 6 – The LCD had a large dead band in midnight (title at the top, artist floating in the middle) and the time and format text were 10px and illegible. FIX: five fixed rows (16/22/18/16/16 px tall with 4–6px gaps) filling y 58–162 exactly, with the type scale below.

DEFECT 7 – In the visualizer theme the idle spectrum drew as a flat dashed line. FIX: 28 bars, 5px wide with ~3px gaps across x 178–398. Bars are bottom-aligned at y=122, max height 40, drawn behind the title and artist at 32% opacity, with 2px peak caps at 100% opacity that fall at 40px/s. Smoothing: attack 0.6, release 0.12, at 30fps. When idle, show a slow 0.25Hz sine 'breathing' pattern of 2–6px so it never reads as a line.

DEFECT 8 – The '음량' text label, the slider and '30%' did not align with anything, and the nav labels floated at the far right. FIX: the volume group spans exactly the bezel width (x 16–148) and the nav segmented control spans exactly LCD plus pad (x 164–564). Both sit on y 188–220.

DEFECT 9 – The expanded drawer duplicated navigation (rail plus tabs), used 62px rows with text jammed against the top, and clipped the third row ('LOCAL · 로컬 음악' was cut off) behind the bottom actions. FIX: the rail is the tab bar. Rows are a fixed 52px with text vertically centred as an 18+2+16px block. The list viewport and footer are separate QVBoxLayout items with an 8px gap.

DEFECT 10 – Source filters ('LOCAL YOUTUBE') and actions ('폴더', '새로고침', '검색') were unframed text that looked like labels. FIX: a two-segment toggle, plus folder-plus and refresh icon buttons with tooltips. Search runs on Enter, and there is a leading search icon inside the field, so no separate '검색' button is needed.

DEFECT 11 – The 'LOCAL 3' footer and the resize grip cluttered the compact shell. FIX: remove them. Track count moves to the drawer header. Vertical resizing in expanded mode uses an invisible 6px bottom edge zone with SizeVerCursor.
DEFECT 12 – The scrollbar was a thick bar inset from the edge. FIX: a 4px overlay scrollbar at x=548 that fades in and out.

TYPE SCALE (px): window brand 12 Semibold; LCD title 15 Bold; LCD artist 12 Regular; LCD badge 10 Bahnschrift SemiCondensed; LCD time 12 Bahnschrift SemiCondensed; nav label 12 Regular (Semibold when active); list title 13 Semibold; list meta 12 Regular; duration 12 Bahnschrift SemiCondensed; button 12 Semibold; tooltip 12 Regular. Never set Hangul below 12px. Malgun Gothic only has Regular, Bold and Semilight, so map weights 600 and above to Bold and do not request 500.

FONT SETUP: QFont.setFamilies(['Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic']) so Latin renders in Segoe and Hangul falls back to Malgun Gothic. Numeric widgets use setFamilies(['Bahnschrift SemiCondensed', 'Bahnschrift', 'Segoe UI']) with font.setFeature('tnum', 1) on PySide6 ≥ 6.7. Use setHintingPreference(PreferVerticalHinting) for crisper Hangul at 12–13px. Use pixel sizes (setPixelSize), not point sizes, so the coordinates above stay exact. Keep letter-spacing at 0 for Hangul; only Latin badges get +0.8px.

ICON SYSTEM: one SVG set on a 24×24 viewBox: stroke 1.75, round caps and joins, no fill except play, pause, prev and next. Render through QSvgRenderer into a QPixmap at size × devicePixelRatio. Recolor with CompositionMode_SourceIn to the state color (rest = text at 82%, hover = text 100%, active = accent, disabled = text 32%). Cache one pixmap per (icon, size, color, dpr). Sizes: 24 play key, 20 direction keys, 18 everything else, 16 inline chevrons. Every clickable icon sits in a 32×32 hit target.

SHELL PAINT (all themes): use a frameless window with WA_TranslucentBackground. Paint a radius-18 QPainterPath, antialiased. Draw a 1px outer border in the theme border color, then a 1px inner highlight inset 1px (top half only, fading via a vertical gradient from the highlight color to transparent at 50%). Optional shadow: paint it manually with two stacked rounded rects (0,4,16 at 18% black; 0,1,3 at 12% black) inside the 12px margin, not QGraphicsDropShadowEffect on the root.

LCD screen vertical #2B66C4 → #1A4C9C (45%) → #0F3373; glass sheen is a top 40% band rgba(255,255,255,0.10)→0; inner shadow is a 1px top line rgba(0,0,0,0.35). Bezel conic: #1A2A2C 0, #0B1214 0.25, #24393B 0.5, #0B1214 0.75, #1A2A2C 1, with a 1px outer glow ring rgba(62,240,192,0.35) whose alpha pulses 0.25–0.55 with the RMS level. Progress arc uses a QConicalGradient #3EF0C0 → #7A7CFF. LCD screen vertical #06191D → #041114 → #020A0C, inner border 1px rgba(62,240,192,0.28). LCD text #E6FFF7, muted #86A8A0, accent #3EF0C0. Rail #0B1013, border #1E2A2E, active #13201F with a 1px rgba(62,240,192,0.45) border. Drawer #0B0F13.

TACTILE STATES (pad and play key): at rest, paint a 0,2,6 shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.22) under the play key (0.45 on dark themes). Hover brightens the gradient by 6% (scale stop lightness). Pressed moves the key 1px down, removes the shadow, darkens 8% and adds a 1px inner top shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.25). For direction keys, hover paints a 32px circle in text color at 8%, and pressed paints it at 14% with the icon 1px lower. Add a 90ms ease-out transition with QVariantAnimation on a 0–1 'press' property.

CONTRAST CHECK (WCAG): silver_blue text #18202E on #F4F7FB ≈ 15.6:1, muted #56637A ≈ 5.9:1, LCD text #EEF5FF on #1A4C9C ≈ 8.3:1. midnight text on #161C2B ≈ 14.5:1, muted ≈ 6.1:1. warm_cream text on #FAF5EC ≈ 15:1, muted #6B5B49 ≈ 6.3:1. visualizer text on #0E1218 ≈ 18:1, muted ≈ 6.4:1. Accent orange #E8780C with a white glyph ≈ 3.0:1, which meets the 3:1 non-text requirement for the play glyph. Never use the accent as a text color for 12px Hangul body text; use it only for titles of 13px and up, or for icons.

SPACING RULES: 4px base grid. 16px outer padding and object gutters. 12px drawer inner padding. 8px between toolbar controls. 6px between an icon and its label. 4px between stacked text lines. Button and input radius 8, segmented container radius 10, drawer radius 14, shell radius 18, LCD radius 12. All heights are 32 (controls), 52 (rows) or 16/18/22 (text lines). There are no other values.

IMPLEMENTATION GUARDRAILS for the coder: build the deck (bezel, LCD, pad) as QWidgets with custom paintEvent and absolute setGeometry using the coordinates above, not nested QHBoxLayouts. Box layouts caused the drift seen in the screenshots. Use layouts only inside the drawer. Store every theme color and gradient stop in one dict keyed by theme id (silver_blue, midnight, warm_cream, visualizer), and repaint with update() when the theme changes. Ban Unicode symbol glyphs (◇ ⚙ ‹ › ↻ ⤨ ▶ ❚❚ ✕ –) anywhere in the UI. The only exception is the '·' separator in text.

QA CHECKLIST: take screenshots at 100%, 125% and 150% scaling of all 4 themes × compact and expanded (library, queue, playlists, video). Verify the y=108 centre line with a debug overlay toggle (Ctrl+Shift+G draws the 4px grid and object bounds). Verify no row clipping at window heights 520, 640 and 900. Verify that long Korean titles ('아주 긴 한국어 노래 제목이 들어가는 경우의 말줄임 테스트') elide cleanly in the LCD and the list. Verify keyboard focus rings appear only with Tab.
